arxiv-2205-14171.description: Abstract We consider a standard Ginzburg-Landau model of a ferroelectric whose electrical polarization is coupled to gradients of elastic strain Zubko et al. 2013 ; Yudin and Tagantsev 2013 ; Tagantsev and Yudin 2016 ; Wang et al. 2019 .

arxiv-2306-10883.title: The 3 d and 5 d electronic structures and orbital hybridization in Ba- and Ca-doped La 2 CoIrO 6 double perovskite
arxiv-2306-10883.creator: J. R. L. Mardegan, L. S. I. Veiga, T. Pohlmann, S. S. Dhesi, S. Francoual, J. R. Jesus, C. Macchiutti, E. M. Bittar, L. Bufaiçal
arxiv-2306-10883.description: Abstract Here we present a detailed investigation of the Co and Ir local electronic structures in La A 0.5 1.5 {}_{1.5}A_{0.5} CoIrO 6 ( A A = Ba, Ca) compounds in order to unravel the orbital hybridization mechanism in these CoIr-based double perovskites.

arxiv-2407-02842.title: MindBench : A Comprehensive Benchmark for Mind Map Structure Recognition and Analysis
arxiv-2407-02842.creator: Lei ChenMeituanBeijing, China 100012 leichen1997@outlook.com Feng YanMeituanBeijing, China 100012 yanfeng05@meituan.com Yujie ZhongMeituanBeijing, China 100012 zhongyujie@meituan.com Shaoxiang ChenMeituanBeijing, China 100012 chenshaoxiang@meituan.com, Zequn JieMeituanBeijing, China 100012 jiezequn@
arxiv-2407-02842.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) have made significant progress in the field of document analysis. Despite this, existing benchmarks typically focus only on extracting text and simple layout information, neglecting the complex interactions between elements in structured documents such as mind maps and flowcharts.

arxiv-2503-04261.title: VirtualXAI: A User-Centric Framework for Explainability Assessment Leveraging GPT-Generated Personas
arxiv-2503-04261.creator: 1 st Georgios Makridis, 2 nd Vasileios Koukos, 3 rd Georgios Fatouros, 4 th Dimosthenis Kyriazis
arxiv-2503-04261.description: Abstract In today’s data-driven era, computational systems generate vast amounts of data that drive the digital transformation of industries, where Artificial Intelligence (AI) plays a key role. Currently, the demand for eXplainable AI (XAI) has increased to enhance the interpretability, transparency, and trustworthiness of AI models.

arxiv-2504-17389.title: Directed and elliptic flow of light nuclei and hypernuclei in Au+Au collisions at s NN = 3 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=3 GeV: Coalescence vs. Statistical Fragmentation
arxiv-2504-17389.creator: Tom Reichert, Manjunath Omana Kuttan, Apiwit Kittiratpattana, Nihal Buyukcizmeci, Alexander Botvina, Jan Steinheimer, Marcus Bleicher
arxiv-2504-17389.description: Abstract The harmonic flow coefficients of light nuclei and hypernuclei in Au+Au collisions at s NN = 3 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=3 GeV are investigated using the Ultra-relativistic Quantum Molecular Dynamics transport model. For the Equation-of-State we employ a density and momentum dependent potential from the Chiral-Mean-Field model.

arxiv-2505-21868.title: Cross-DINO: Cross the Deep MLP and Transformer for Small Object Detection Thanks: Manuscript received 28 August, 2024; revised 27 December, 2024, and 3 February, 2025; accepted 3 February, 2025. This work was supported in part by the National Key Research and Development Program of China under Grant
arxiv-2505-21868.creator: Guiping Cao, Wenjian Huang, Xiangyuan Lan, Jianguo Zhang, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2505-21868.description: Abstract Small Object Detection (SOD) poses significant challenges due to limited information and the model’s low class prediction score. While Transformer-based detectors have shown promising performance, their potential for SOD remains largely unexplored. In typical DETR-like frameworks, the CNN backbone network, specialized in aggregating local information, struggles to capture the necessary contextual information for SOD.

arxiv-2507-10589.title: Comparative Analysis of Vision Transformers and Traditional Deep Learning Approaches for Automated Pneumonia Detection in Chest X-Rays
arxiv-2507-10589.creator: Gaurav Singh
arxiv-2507-10589.description: Abstract Pneumonia, particularly when induced by diseases like COVID-19, remains a critical global health challenge requiring rapid and accurate diagnosis. This study presents a comprehensive comparison of traditional machine learning and state-of-the-art deep learning approaches for automated pneumonia detection using chest X-rays (CXRs).

arxiv-2510-17764.title: Evaluating Medical LLMs by Levels of Autonomy: A Survey Moving from Benchmarks to Applications
arxiv-2510-17764.creator: Xiao Ye Jacob Dineen Zhaonan Li Zhikun Xu Weiyu Chen, Shijie Lu Yuxi Huang Ming Shen Phu Tran Ji–Eun Irene Yum, Muhammad Ali Khan Muhammad Umar Afzal Irbaz Bin Riaz Ben Zhou, [0.25em] Arizona State University
arxiv-2510-17764.description: Abstract Medical Large language models achieve strong scores on standard benchmarks; however, the transfer of those results to safe and reliable performance in clinical workflows remains a challenge. This survey reframes evaluation through a levels-of-autonomy lens (L0–L3), spanning informational tools, information transformation and aggregation, decision support, and supervised agents.

arxiv-2512-21154.title: Limits of equi-affine equi-distant loci of planar convex domains with two non-parallel asymptotes
arxiv-2512-21154.creator: Nikita Kalinin, Mikhail Shkolnikov
arxiv-2512-21154.description: Abstract In this note we discuss the novel approach to define equi-affine invariants starting from tropical geometry, where one averages over the space of tropical structures of fixed co-volume. Applied to the tropical distance series, this gives a family of equi-affine invariant functions associated with convex domains which are expected to satisfy a number of remarkable properties.

pmc-11437493.title: Comparative Effects of Efavirenz and Dolutegravir on Metabolomic and Inflammatory Profiles, and Platelet Activation of People Living with HIV: A Pilot Study
pmc-11437493.creator: Crystal G. Roux, Shayne Mason, Louise D. V. du Toit, Jan-Gert Nel, Theresa M. Rossouw, Helen C. Steel
pmc-11437493.description: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) has reduced the mortality and morbidity associated with HIV. However, irrespective of treatment, people living with HIV remain at a higher risk of developing non-AIDS-associated diseases. In 2019, the World Health Organization recommended the transition from efavirenz (EFV)- to dolutegravir (DTG)-based ART. Data on the impact of this transition are still limited.

pmc-12652404.title: Climate-Related Heat Stress and Psychological Outcomes in Self-Employed Delivery Workers: Evidence from Brasília, Brazil
pmc-12652404.creator: Carlos Manoel Lopes Rodrigues, Lígia Abreu Gomes Cruz, Delfina Gabriela Garrido Ramos, João dos Santos Baptista, Joana Cristina Cardoso Guedes
pmc-12652404.description: This study examines whether daily heat exposure worsens psychological well-being among self-employed motorcycle delivery workers in Brasília, Brazil. Using ecological momentary assessment over 15 consecutive days in August 2025, 45 workers were recruited and 30 (66.7%) completed twice-daily mobile prompts (12:00 and 18:00) rating stress, fatigue, mood, and perceived heat (1–5 scales) and reporting kilometers traveled.

pmc-12654590.title: Integrating Orientation Optimization and Thermal Distortion Prediction in LPBF: A Validated Framework for Sustainable Additive Manufacturing
pmc-12654590.creator: Nikoletta Sargioti, Elias P Koumoulos, Evangelia K Karaxi, Reza Teimouri
pmc-12654590.description: This study investigates the impact of build orientation on thermal distortion, residual stress behaviour, and process efficiency in LPBF. Four orientation strategies, optimized for surface area, support volume, print time, and overheating, were generated in Siemens NX and evaluated using Atlas 3D to predict build-stage and post-support removal distortion.

pmc-12655889.title: Comparison of Machine Learning Models for Colon Cancer Survival: Predictive Modeling Approach
pmc-12655889.creator: Reuben Adatorwovor, Motolani E Ogunsanya, Bin Huang, Richard Charnigo, Olufunmilola Abraham
pmc-12655889.description: BackgroundColon cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide, with survival influenced by risk factors, treatment type, and patient characteristics. Traditional statistical models, such as Kaplan-Meier curves, have been widely used to estimate survival probabilities. However, these models often have difficulty handling complex interactions, covariates, and nonlinear relationships between risk factors.

pmc-13239378.title: Tobacco use and associated factors among adults in Ghana: evidence from the 2022 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey
pmc-13239378.creator: Divine Darlington Logo, Prakash Babu Kodali, Jerry John Ouner, Judith Anaman-Torgbor, Benjamin W Chaffee, Stella A Bialous
pmc-13239378.description: AbstractObjectiveTo examine the prevalence and sociodemographic factors associated with tobacco smoking, smokeless tobacco and dual use among adults in Ghana using the 2022 Demographic and Health Survey (GDHS).SettingGhana, nationwide sample of males and females aged ≥15 years.DesignThis was a cross-sectional secondary analysis of the 2022 GDHS.

pmc-13270038.creator: Ravi Shankar, Vahul Sundar, Karen Sui Geok Chua

pmc-13348562.title: Chronic liver disease questionnaire analysis in pregnant women with hepatitis B: a prospective study
pmc-13348562.creator: Yueying Deng, Weizhen Chen, Ying Lin, Tingting Peng, Dan Xie, Ziren Chen, Shi OuYang
pmc-13348562.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAlthough domestic and international guidelines increasingly emphasize preventing mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of hepatitis B virus (HBV), the multidimensional impacts of HBV infection on pregnant women’s health-related quality of life (HRQoL) have received insufficient attention. Our previous 1:1 matched cohort study [1] identified HBV infection as an independent risk factor for impaired HRQoL in pregnant women, after adjusting for age, gestational age, and parity.

pmc-13393571.title: Integrating Psychological Care into Pediatric Sports Medicine: Levels of Collaboration and Common Referral Concerns
pmc-13393571.creator: Chelsey Bowman, Sabrina Gretkierewicz, Jacqueline M. Pabis, Abigail Bushnell, Rachel Sweenie, Casey Lawless, Jamie Shoop, Morgan Daffin, Emily J. Stapleton, Kirby Knapp, Catherine Butz
pmc-13393571.description: It is well established that psychological factors impact sport injuries, recovery, and return to sport among youth athletes. Medical associations and sport governing bodies have advocated for the assessment and intervention of mental health concerns among athletes. However, there is less research on methods of incorporating pediatric psychology services within sports medicine (SM) settings.

pmc-13533221.title: A Platform for the Actuation of Magnetically Labeled Skeletal Muscle Cells Using Dynamic Magnetic Stimulation
pmc-13533221.creator: Tayná C. Rodrigues, Anna‐Lena Bauknecht, Anna Gioran, Sabine Rosenfeldt, Daniel Dickes, Johann Schorzmann, Frank Döpper, Elisabetta A. Cavalcanti‐Adam, Michael Maier, Reinhard Richter, Marissa K. Caldow, Gordon S. Lynch, Daniel E. Heath, Andrea J. O'Connor, Sahar Salehi
pmc-13533221.description: Engineering skeletal muscle tissues with controllable bioactuation is essential for advances in biohybrid robotics, regenerative medicine, and high‐fidelity disease models. Mechanical stimulation has been shown to replicate the effects of physical exercise, while magnetic stimulation allows the manipulation of cells in a non‐invasive manner. Here, a platform based on Helmholtz coil pair for magnetic stimulation is developed.
